turns.message: Is overnight delivery an option and what will it set me back?
turns.reply: Yes, overnight shipping is available in the continental US, arriving the next business day for $29.95 [5]. It is not available for PO boxes or APO, FPO and DPO military addresses [6].

turns.message: Can I still edit the address if the box already left your warehouse?
turns.reply: Once a parcel has shipped, we cannot redirect it [1]. You may be able to redirect it through the carrier's tracking page [1].

turns.message: Do you send things to APO addresses?
turns.reply: Yes, standard shipping can be sent to APO addresses, as well as to FPO and DPO military addresses and PO boxes [1]. Express and overnight shipping are not available for these addresses [1].

turns.message: How long is a gift message allowed to be?
turns.reply: A gift message can be up to 200 characters, and it is free to include with a gift order [1].

turns.message: When do you bill me for something that's backordered?
turns.reply: Your card is charged when the backordered item ships, not when you order [1].

turns.message: I'd like a bigger size, what's the quickest way to swap?
turns.reply: To swap for a bigger size, start a return and place a new order for the size you want [1]. This is the fastest way because it does not wait for the return to arrive [1].

turns.message: My mum bought me a lamp as a present, can I send it back without her knowing?
turns.reply: Yes, gift recipients can return an item using the order number from the packing slip [6]. The refund is issued as store credit to the recipient, and the buyer is not notified [6].

turns.message: What do you need from me to claim on the warranty?
turns.reply: To claim under warranty, send support your order number, a short description of the fault and a photo or video [1]. We reply within 3 business days with a repair, replacement part, or replacement item [1].

turns.message: Is it possible to spread the payments out?
turns.reply: Yes, orders between $75 and $1,500 can be split into 4 interest-free payments taken every 2 weeks, with the first payment due at checkout [1]. Approval depends on the payment partner's checks, and gift cards cannot be bought this way [1].

turns.message: Does my leftover credit ever run out?
turns.reply: Store credit does not expire [1]. However, unused store credit is lost if your account is permanently closed [2].

turns.message: I need to use a different email on my profile
turns.reply: Go to Account, then Profile, and edit your email address [1]. We send a confirmation link to the new address, and the change takes effect only after you select it [1].

turns.message: Can I check out without signing up?
turns.reply: Yes, you can order without an account through guest checkout [1]. Guest orders can be tracked with the link in the order email [1].

turns.message: Stop sending me promotional mail please, how?
turns.reply: Unsubscribe from marketing using the link at the bottom of any marketing email, or under Account, then Notifications [4]. You will still receive order and security emails [4].

turns.message: Can I freeze my Plus subscription for a couple of months?
turns.reply: Yes, if you are a monthly member you can pause Fernwick Plus for up to 3 months once per year under Account, then Membership [2]. Annual memberships cannot be paused [2].

turns.message: How high does the standing desk go?
turns.reply: The Rise standing desk adjusts from 72 cm to 120 cm in height [1].

turns.message: How many gadgets can the keyboard remember?
turns.reply: The Quill wireless keyboard remembers up to 3 devices [1].

turns.message: Will you take my old desk away?
turns.reply: When you buy a Fernwick chair or desk, we can collect and recycle your old one for $19 [2]. Add the Recycle old furniture option at checkout [2].

turns.message: We want to buy 15 monitor arms, is there a better price?
turns.reply: Orders of 10 or more units of the same item qualify for business pricing, so 15 monitor arms would qualify [6]. Send the product names, quantities and delivery location to support, and a quote is sent within 2 business days [6].

turns.message: Are you open on Sundays?
turns.reply: We are closed on Sundays [1].

turns.message: If the price goes down next week, do I get money back?
turns.reply: If the price of an item drops within 14 days of your purchase, contact support and we refund the difference as store credit [1]. This does not apply to clearance, lightning deals or other retailers' prices [1].

turns.message: How long before a pending authorisation disappears?
turns.reply: If the order is cancelled, a pending authorisation drops off your statement within 3 to 7 business days [1].

turns.message: What happens to my refund if I paid with a gift card?
turns.reply: I don't know the answer to that from our help center, so I won't guess. Would you like me to pass this to a human support agent?

turns.message: Do you have a policy for lost parcels?
turns.reply: Yes: if tracking shows no movement for 3 business days, or your parcel is more than 3 business days past the estimated date, contact support and we will open a carrier trace [1]. A trace takes up to 5 business days, and if the carrier confirms the parcel is lost, we send a replacement or refund the order [1]. If tracking says delivered but you cannot find it, check around the property, with neighbours and with your building's mailroom, wait 1 business day, then report it within 14 days of the delivery date so we can file a claim [2].

turns.message: Is the annual fee charged automatically after the trial?
turns.reply: Yes, if you do not cancel before the trial ends, the membership starts and your default card is charged [1]. We email a reminder 3 days before the trial ends [1].

turns.message: Can I delete a saved card from my account?
turns.reply: Yes, you can delete a saved card by going to Account, then Payment methods, and selecting Remove [2]. If the card is the one used for your Fernwick Plus renewal, set a new card as Default to change it [2].

turns.message: What should I do if I get an email asking for my password?
turns.reply: Fernwick Goods never asks for your password or full card number by email, text or phone [2]. Do not click any links in the message, and forward it to security@fernwick.example [2]. Official Fernwick Goods emails come from addresses ending in @fernwick.example [2].

turns.message: The headset firmware update keeps failing, bit frustrating. Any tips?
turns.reply: Update the firmware using the Murmur app on Windows or macOS, with the headset connected by its USB cable [1]. Keep the headset plugged in throughout, and expect the update to take about 5 minutes [1].
